instruction: Please configure Chrome's default text size to the smallest available option.

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting Chrome's default text size to the smallest option (typically 9-10). Evaluator checks if default_font_size is in range [9, 12). Original task checks for largest size (16+), this checks for smallest size (9-11). Using existing get_chrome_font_size getter and fixed check_font_size metric with correct range comparison.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic is CORRECT and can properly verify the instruction.
Getter logic (get_chrome_font_size) correctly reads Chrome Preferences file and extracts default_font_size from webkit.webprefs settings.

Metric logic (check_font_size) correctly implements range comparison with inclusive lower bound and exclusive upper bound: 'rule['min'] <= default_font_size < rule['max']'. This properly evaluates range [9, 12) to accept values 9, 10, 11.

Expected range [9, 12) is semantically appropriate for 'smallest available option'. Chrome's smallest font size is typically 9-10, so range covers 9, 10, 11 which correctly targets smallest sizes without being too permissive.
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure Preferences file is written and persisted, allowing verification of the saved setting.
Complete instruction coverage: evaluator checks that default text size was configured to smallest option (9-11 range).
